payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning'. A vows post is low commercial intent, so the commercial question only peaks once the reader reaches where they will marry and who will travel to hear the vows. The panel moved the legal section below the examples so the primary invitation follows the evidence and sits beside the overseas note; it stays the only Advisor claim in the body, with the closing CTA ending the post and the magazine serving readers still collecting ideas. The secondary in the destination examples intro was kept by the panel for destination readers. Subtexts use only brand-facts lines 19 to 28: single point of contact, start to finish, time zone, inclusions confirmed in writing. All money, rate, payment and availability wording is left out, matching the panel's deferred list. A printable short vows template card would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
